module purpose: neorv32_cpu_cp_bitmanip decodes the instruction fields carried on ctrl_i into a one-hot bit-manipulation command, captures rs1_i, rs2_i, shamt_i and the comparator bit of cmp_i when ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu is set, computes the selected result directly or through a multi-cycle serial shifter or carry-less multiplier sequenced by an idle/start/busy controller, and drives the result on res_o, registered and qualified by a one-cycle valid pulse that is also driven on valid_o.

use-case flows.value: acceptance of a bit-manipulation operation: the one-hot command decoded from ctrl_i instruction fields, the trigger decision valid_cmd, and the start pulses of the serial shifter and the carry-less multiplier
operand capture: rs1_i, rs2_i, shamt_i and the comparator less-than bit stored when ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu is 1

per-operation results computed from the captured operands (logic, min/max, extension, byte operations, shift-add, single-bit operations, pack, zip, bit reverse; barrel shifter, popcount and leading-zero count when EN_FAST_SHIFT)
multi-cycle serial shift, rotate, count-zeros and population count (when not EN_FAST_SHIFT): shift register, iteration count, iteration target and running decision
multi-cycle carry-less multiplication (when EN_ZBKC): product accumulator, down counter and running decision
controller sequencing S_IDLE -> S_START -> S_BUSY -> S_IDLE, ending when both units stop or ctrl_i.cpu_trap is 1
result selection by the command, OR-combination and registered delivery on res_o while valid is 1
completion event: one-cycle valid pulse that qualifies res_o and is exported on valid_o
controller state, operand registers, start pulses, valid, serial shifter registers, carry-less multiplier registers and res_o cleared while rstn_i is 0

conceptual assets.concept: Operation request acceptance -- the decision that a bit-manipulation operation is triggered, and the start pulses that launch the multi-cycle units
conceptual assets.reasoning: `valid_cmd <= '1' when (ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu = '1') and (or_reduce_f(cmd) = '1') else '0';` (line 164) decides that an operation is requested; in S_IDLE `if (valid_cmd = '1') then` (line 199) starts it: `shifter.start <= '1';` (line 201) for count/rotate when not EN_FAST_SHIFT (line 200), `clmul.start <= '1';` (line 204) for carry-less multiply, otherwise an immediate valid (line 207). shifter.start GATES the loads of shifter.cnt, shifter.sreg, shifter.cnt_max and shifter.bcnt (line 241) and clmul.start GATES the loads of clmul.cnt and clmul.res (line 358). Integrity is Established: a wrong decision starts, skips or misloads an operation (lines 242-249, 359-360). Availability is Established under the implemented conditions: with valid_cmd = 1 in S_IDLE at a clock edge exactly one of the three actions occurs (lines 199-209), and each pulse is cleared the next cycle (lines 182-183). valid_cmd computes the decision (GATED_BY ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu, occurrence 2, line 164); shifter.start and clmul.start store it (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at occurrence 4, lines 201 and 204, each with a GATES record on other elements). ctrl_i is a control record port named whole, not a transport record (the fields used here are instruction fields and control bits, no address, data or acknowledge transaction); its field alu_cp_alu GATES valid_cmd on line 164 (port occurrence 64), so ctrl_i sets the trigger. Configuration: shifter.start can become 1 only when not EN_FAST_SHIFT (line 200) and is read only in serial_shifter (line 241); clmul.start can become 1 only when EN_ZBKC makes cmd(op_clmul_c) reachable (line 161) and is read only in clmul_enable (line 358). cmd also feeds this decision and is reported under operation selection. Confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Operation selection -- the decoded one-hot command that decides which bit-manipulation operation is performed and which result is delivered
conceptual assets.reasoning: Lines 132-161 compute each cmd bit from ctrl_i.ir_opcode, ctrl_i.ir_funct12 and ctrl_i.ir_funct3, each under its extension generic (EN_ZBB or EN_ZBKB, EN_ZBA, EN_ZBS, EN_ZBKB, EN_ZBKC). The command decides which per-operation term reaches res_o, as in `res_out(op_andn_c) <= res_int(op_andn_c) when (EN_ZBB or EN_ZBKB) and (cmd(op_andn_c) = '1') else (others => '0');` (line 461) and lines 462-480, which multi-cycle unit starts (lines 200, 203), the serial shift direction (lines 251-252), the iteration target (line 244), the fill bit (line 266) and the running decision (line 274). Integrity is Established: a wrong command bit delivers another operation's result or sequencing for the same instruction. cmd computes the decision (GATED_BY ctrl_i.ir_funct3, occurrence 2, line 132). ctrl_i sets it: its field ir_funct3 GATES cmd on line 132 (port occurrence 2), and ir_funct3 and ir_funct12 also pick result variants directly (lines 402, 405-406, 436, 447, 456). Confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Captured operands -- the source operand words and shift amount held for the operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: When `if (ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu = '1') then` (line 187) holds at a clock edge, `rs1_reg <= rs1_i;` (line 189), `rs2_reg <= rs2_i;` (line 190) and `sha_reg <= shamt_i;` (line 191) capture the operands that every computation reads: rs1_reg in lines 243, 301, 310, 313, 360 and 389-452; rs2_reg in lines 334, 364, 389-391, 402 and 436; sha_reg forms the one-hot bit mask (line 343) and the barrel shift amount (line 298). Integrity is Established: the result is defined as the selected function of these values, e.g. `res_int(op_andn_c) <= rs1_reg and (not rs2_reg);` (line 389), so a wrong capture yields a wrong result. rs1_i, rs2_i and shamt_i set the operands (CARRIES into rs1_reg, rs2_reg, sha_reg at occurrence 2). rs1_reg stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 3) and its records show a use beyond internal data: GATES res_int on line 431. sha_reg stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 3) and SELECTS one_hot_res (line 343). rs2_reg is not listed: its records show only SOURCES into internal elements (adder_res line 334, clmul.res line 364, res_int lines 389-437), so under the register-use rule it holds one step of a value that those computations carry on; that value enters at rs2_i. Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts who observes the operands.

conceptual assets.concept: Comparison outcome -- the captured less-than flag that decides which operand the max/min operations return
conceptual assets.reasoning: `less_reg <= cmp_i(cmp_less_c);` (line 188) captures the comparator bit under ctrl_i.alu_cp_alu (line 187), and `res_int(op_max_c) <= rs1_reg when ((less_reg xor ctrl_i.ir_funct3(1)) = '1') else rs2_reg;` (line 402) uses it to decide which operand the max/min family returns. Confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Controller sequencing state -- the idle/start/busy state of the coprocessor operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: ctrl_state is reset to S_IDLE (line 172), moves S_IDLE -> S_START when a serial unit is started (lines 202, 205) or stays S_IDLE with valid (line 208), S_START -> S_BUSY (line 214), and S_BUSY -> S_IDLE (line 220) when `if ((shifter.run = '0') and (clmul.run = '0')) or (ctrl_i.cpu_trap = '1') then` (line 218) holds. Through `case ctrl_state is` (line 195) the state decides whether start pulses (lines 201, 204) and valid (lines 207, 219) are produced. Integrity is Established: a wrong state accepts operations outside S_IDLE or ends a busy operation before its units stop. Availability is Established under the implemented conditions: new operations are accepted only in S_IDLE (line 199), and from S_BUSY the controller returns to S_IDLE when both units stop or a trap is signalled (lines 218-220). ctrl_state stores the state (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4) and SELECTS valid (line 195). ctrl_i sets the trap-forced return through its field cpu_trap (GATES ctrl_state, port occurrence 66, line 218). shifter.run and clmul.run, which also gate line 218, are reported under the multi-cycle termination concept.

conceptual assets.concept: Multi-cycle iteration progress and termination -- the iteration counts, the iteration target and the running decisions that end a serial shift/count or carry-less multiply
conceptual assets.reasoning: Serial shifter (not EN_FAST_SHIFT): shifter.cnt is cleared at start (line 242) and incremented while running (line 257); shifter.cnt_max is loaded at start with XLEN for population count or with shamt_i otherwise (lines 244-247); `if (shifter.cnt = shifter.cnt_max) then` (line 281) clears shifter.run (line 282), and for count-zeros the run decision tests the end bit of the shift register (lines 276, 278). Carry-less multiply (EN_ZBKC): clmul.cnt is loaded with XLEN (line 359) and decremented while running (line 362); `clmul.run <= '1' when (or_reduce_f(clmul.cnt) = '1') else '0';` (line 374). The run decisions gate each iteration (lines 250, 361) and the controller's completion (line 218). Integrity is Established: the iteration count fixes how far the operand is shifted or rotated and how many partial products are accumulated (lines 253-259, 363-368), and shifter.cnt is itself the count-zeros result (line 395). Availability is Established under the implemented conditions: the operation ends and valid is produced when the count reaches its target or clmul.cnt reaches zero (lines 218-219). shifter.run computes (CONSTRAINED_BY shifter.cnt, occurrence 6, line 282); clmul.run computes (GATED_BY clmul.cnt, occurrence 4, line 374); shifter.cnt stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4) and CONSTRAINS shifter.run (line 281); shifter.cnt_max stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 5) and CONSTRAINS shifter.run (line 281); clmul.cnt stores (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 5) and GATES clmul.run (line 374); shamt_i sets the shift target (SOURCES shifter.cnt_max, occurrence 3, line 247). Configuration: with EN_FAST_SHIFT, shifter.run and shifter.cnt_max are tied to zero (lines 317, 319) and shifter.cnt is the combinational leading-zero count of rs1_reg (lines 313-314); without EN_ZBKC, clmul.cnt and clmul.run are tied to zero (lines 380, 382).

conceptual assets.concept: Serial shift register state -- the operand word being shifted, rotated or scanned by the serial shifter
conceptual assets.reasoning: shifter.sreg is loaded with rs1_reg at start (line 243) and shifted one position per running cycle, left or right as cmd, ctrl_i.ir_funct3 and ctrl_i.ir_funct12 decide (lines 251-255), with the fill bit shifter.nxt (lines 266-268). Its value is the rotate result (`res_int(op_rot_c) <= shifter.sreg;`, line 414), its bit 0 decides the population-count increment (line 258) and its end bits decide the count-zeros running decision (lines 276, 278). Integrity is Established: a corrupted shift register changes the rotate result, the population count (line 259) and the count-zeros result. shifter.sreg stores it (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4, line 253) and GATES shifter.bcnt (occurrence 10, line 258). Configuration: with EN_FAST_SHIFT it is the combinational barrel-shifter output (line 307). Not listed: shifter.bcnt (population-count accumulator, lines 249, 259) and clmul.res (carry-less product accumulator, lines 360-368), because their records show only data into internal elements (CARRIES res_int line 399; SOURCES res_int line 456) and self-updates, so under the register-use rule the value they hold is carried on through res_int to res_o; shifter.nxt, bs_level and bs_shift are parts of the shift computation.

conceptual assets.concept: Completion event -- the one-cycle valid pulse that announces a finished operation and qualifies the delivered result
conceptual assets.reasoning: valid is cleared every cycle (line 184), set for single-cycle operations in S_IDLE (line 207) and on completion or trap in S_BUSY (line 219). It decides whether res_o is loaded (`if (valid = '1') then`, line 491) and leaves the entity as `valid_o <= valid;` (line 502). Integrity is Established: valid must mark exactly the cycle in which res_o holds the selected result (lines 490-496), and valid_o is delivered across the output boundary to a consumer not supplied, so the consumer must receive exactly the completion the flow defines (line 502). Availability is Established under the implemented conditions of lines 199-209 and 218-219. valid stores the event (CLOCKED_BY clk_i, occurrence 4) with GATES res_o and CARRIES valid_o; valid_o is the exit port (COPIES valid, occurrence 2); ctrl_i sets the trap-forced completion through its field cpu_trap (GATES valid, port occurrence 66, line 218). Confidentiality is not established.

conceptual assets.concept: Operation result -- the bit-manipulation result delivered to the requester
conceptual assets.reasoning: The result flow keeps one operation's term per command bit (lines 461-480), OR-combines the terms and registers them when valid is 1 (`res_o <= res_out(op_andn_c) or res_out(op_orn_c) ...`, lines 492-496), and drives zero otherwise (line 490). res_o is delivered through an output port to a consumer not supplied, so the integrity property that the consumer receives exactly the selected operation applied to the captured operands is Established from lines 389-456 and 490-496. Availability is Established under the implemented condition: the result is present in the cycle after valid is set (line 491) and cleared otherwise (line 490). res_o is the exit port (DERIVES_FROM res_out, occurrence 4, line 492), ahead of its overlapping storage role (CLOCKED_BY clk_i at the same line). Not listed: res_int holds the per-operation computation terms (lines 389-456) and res_out only gates each term with its command bit (lines 461-480), so both are parts of the computation whose result leaves at res_o; adder_res, one_hot_res, zip_res and unzip_res are likewise computation terms. Confidentiality is not established: no line restricts who observes res_o.
